annotations.title: Buy a plan with USDT or USDC

description: Create an invoice for a plan (plan from list_plans; network base for USDC on Base, or tron, solana or ethereum for USDT): returns invoice_id, pay_to, asset, the exact amount, expires_at, and a bearer token (shown once) that activates when paid; invoice_status with invoice_id shows when it is paid. Meant for after the user has approved the spend. The token is a secret.

network.description: chain and coin you will pay with: base (USDC), tron, solana or ethereum (USDT); send exactly the returned amount of the returned asset to pay_to on that chain

plan.description: plan id from list_plans: pro ($9, higher check limits), team ($49, more watches and evidence export) or seller ($19, 5-minute checks and signed downtime webhooks for a host you claimed — claims are free at POST /v1/claims; no plan changes Trust Score, rank or marks)

name: create_invoice
